intro: Tuition work in Aizawl falls into four zones. Durtlang, Chaltlang & Bawngkawn holds the northern localities, from the Durtlang hilltop through Chaltlang, Bawngkawn and Ramhlun to Zemabawk; Chanmari, Zarkawt & Dawrpui is the centre, around Bara Bazar and McDonald Hill; Tuikual, Vaivakawn & Luangmual reaches out to Luangmual and Tanhril; and Khatla, Mission Veng & Kulikawn covers Khatla, Mission Veng, Bethlehem and Kulikawn. Most families live in multi-storey buildings on steep slopes, sometimes above the road and sometimes below it, and road travel is the only way around the city, so a two-wheeler and a good sense of landmarks do most of the work.

The state board has its office in the city itself: the Mizoram Board of School Education, at Chaltlang, conducts the HSLC examination at the end of Class 10 and the HSSLC at the end of Class 12. Its website publishes the secondary and higher secondary syllabi, the question design and scheme of examination for both levels, the prescribed textbook lists, previous years' HSLC and HSSLC question papers, and exam routines and results. CBSE students are taught alongside them, from the NCERT books. Name your boards, classes and subjects plainly on your profile so the right requests can find you.

Valleys divide one locality from the next, so a tutor on the same side of a valley is often more practical than one who looks closer on a map. When a family in, say, Tuikual sends a request, NXTutors shortlists two or three tutors, looking first in that locality, then the rest of its zone, then the wider city, then online; the family sees each fee before a free first demo, and can switch later without paying. Heavy rain between April and October slows hill roads, so an online option is worth keeping ready, and online learners can live in any Indian city.

zone_notes.Durtlang, Chaltlang & Bawngkawn: This chain of localities runs from the Durtlang hilltop, the highest point in Aizawl, through Chaltlang and Bawngkawn to Ramhlun and Zemabawk, so a tutor living anywhere along it can cover several homes. Climbing to Durtlang takes longer in heavy rain, and roads into the centre are busy at office hours. In Zemabawk, state rental blocks at Falkland and other larger buildings may record visitors, so ask the family what to expect at the entrance.
zone_notes.Chanmari, Zarkawt & Dawrpui: The centre is reachable from almost every locality but hard to time: Bara Bazar in Dawrpui is crowded in shopping hours, and government offices around McDonald Hill in Zarkawt fill nearby roads at opening and closing. Park a two-wheeler where the family suggests and expect to walk the last part. Chanmari and Chanmari West sit in different wards, and Dawrpui Vengthar is a separate locality from Dawrpui, so confirm the exact address before the first class.
zone_notes.Tuikual, Vaivakawn & Luangmual: Deep valleys separate Tuikual, Dinthar, Vaivakawn and the Luangmual side, so check the road route before agreeing to a home, not just the map. Vaivakawn is where the central and Luangmual groups of localities meet, which makes it easy to reach from both. Tanhril, on the outskirts, has a large institutional campus whose housing may set its own visitor rules, and a tutor from the centre faces a longer ride there, especially in heavy rain.
zone_notes.Khatla, Mission Veng & Kulikawn: This zone splits into clusters: Khatla with Bungkawn, Maubawk and Lawipu; Mission Veng with Salem Veng and Venghnuai; Bethlehem with College Veng and the Republic localities; Kulikawn with Tlangnuam and Saikhamakawn. Valleys separate them, so list the clusters you can reach in a single trip. On match days the roads around Mualpui in Salem Veng get crowded, and office-hour traffic towards the centre is worth avoiding for start times.

boards: An Aizawl tutor's week can mix MBSE students heading for the HSLC or HSSLC with CBSE students working from NCERT textbooks. Each board keeps its own documents: the Mizoram Board of School Education posts its syllabi, question design, textbook lists and past HSLC and HSSLC papers on mbse.edu.in, and CBSE posts its curriculum and sample papers on its academic portal. Work from those, not forwarded copies. ICSE, ISC, IB or IGCSE specialists can reach students across India online.

board_cards.name: Mizoram Board of School Education (MBSE)
board_cards.note: MBSE, with its office at Chaltlang in Aizawl, conducts the HSLC examination for Class 10 and the HSSLC for Class 12. Its website publishes syllabi for secondary and higher secondary schools, the question design and scheme of examination, prescribed textbook lists and previous years' question papers. Plan lessons from those documents and take exam routines from the board's own site.

board_cards.name: CBSE
board_cards.note: CBSE students in Aizawl may live in the same building as MBSE students, so be clear on your profile which you teach. Base lessons on the NCERT textbooks, practise with CBSE's own sample papers and marking schemes, and train students to write complete, stepped answers. The same NCERT groundwork in Classes 11 and 12 supports later JEE or NEET preparation.

women.intro: Aizawl's women tutors can teach through NXTutors at students' homes, online or in a mix of the two. The localities you list decide which home requests reach you: a tutor in Khatla might keep to Bungkawn, Maubawk and Lawipu, one in Chaltlang to Bawngkawn and Ramhlun, and others can learn with you online. Many homes are reached by stairs up or down from the road, so asking a parent to come down to the road for the first visit is entirely reasonable. Every tutor who joins goes through the same ID check, a parent is asked to stay in during the demo, and one safeguarding policy applies to tutors and families alike. These are practical controls, not promises about anyone.
points: Choose home, online or both on your profile and change it whenever you like.
List only the localities you can reach in one trip; skipping clusters across a valley is fine.
Agree lesson times with each family before you accept, and keep heavy-rain days online if you prefer.
A free demo opens every new arrangement, and we ask a parent to be at home during it.
In rental blocks or campus housing that keep a visitor record, ask the family to give your name at the entrance.
Settle fees, timing and messages with a parent, not the student.
Teach younger children in a shared room with an adult at home; online, keep both cameras on.
If anything worries you, stop the session and tell NXTutors with the word Safeguarding; in an emergency call 112 first.

story: Sign up on your phone with a one-time code, then add your subjects, classes and boards, such as MBSE or CBSE, and the Aizawl localities you can reach each week.
Upload a government photo ID. Our team checks it before families can see your profile, and each ID links to one tutor account. It confirms identity only; it is not a police check.
After the check, your profile carries the Verified badge, showing your boards, the localities you cover from Durtlang to Kulikawn, whether you teach at home, online or both, and your hourly fee.
A parent in Chanmari or Vaivakawn needs help for a child. The shortlist of two or three draws on tutors near that home before the zone, the whole of Aizawl and finally online tutors.
Your fee is visible to the family before they book. The opening class is a free demo in their flat, with a parent asked to stay in, so the student and the stairs are familiar afterwards.
From there, teach homes within reach, online students anywhere in India, or both, perhaps visiting through the dry months and moving one weekly class online in the heavy April to October rains.
faqs: How do tuition requests in Aizawl reach tutors?

Each request carries the class, board, subjects, locality, a landmark and the chosen mode. The two or three tutors put forward come from that locality where possible, otherwise from its zone, elsewhere in Aizawl or online. Whether you appear depends on the localities and boards on your profile.
Which Aizawl localities should I list on my profile?

The ones you can reach on time every week. Valleys separate many localities, so a tutor in Tuikual might list Dinthar and Vaivakawn, while one in Kulikawn might keep to Tlangnuam, Saikhamakawn and Thakthing. Fewer localities you can always reach beat a long list during the April to October rains.
Can I teach students outside Mizoram online while living in Aizawl?

Yes. With online mode switched on, families anywhere in India can be matched to you, while home requests still favour tutors living close by. You can mix the two: a few home students in their own cluster of localities and the rest on video, timed around the school day.
Which boards can I teach in Aizawl?

Students here may follow the Mizoram Board of School Education, whose HSLC and HSSLC examinations close Classes 10 and 12, and CBSE. List your boards, classes and subjects clearly, and for MBSE students work from the syllabi, question design and textbook lists on the board's website. Other boards can be taught online.
What does the ID check involve for Aizawl tutors?

First a one-time code confirms your mobile number or email address; then our team reviews a government photo ID before any family can see your profile. That establishes identity only. No police or background record is looked at as part of it, and the page /how-we-verify-tutors explains each stage in full.
Do I pay to join NXTutors as a tutor?

Yes, tutor plans carry a charge; /pricing sets out each plan and its features. What you charge families is your own decision and shows on your profile before their free first demo. Families may move to another tutor at no cost, so careful preparation is what holds a student over a term.
Can a woman tutor in Aizawl keep home visits to localities near her own?

Yes. Home requests follow the localities you list, so you might accept visits only around Khatla or Chaltlang and teach every other student online. A parent is asked to stay in for the free demo, which lets you judge the household before agreeing to a regular timetable.
Can one Aizawl student have both home and online lessons with me?

Yes. Turn on both modes, then settle the balance with the parent once the demo is over. Weekly visits to the flat, with one session shifted to video during the heaviest rain between April and October, keep a routine going when hill roads are slow.
